lessons.text: In Luau type annotations the Roblox player class type is Player (for example `player: Player`). `Players.Player` is not a type and fails the type check.
lessons.source: learned-20261014: In Luau type annotations the Roblox player class type is Pla
lessons.evidence: STAR night school, server 1, attempts.jsonl 2026-10-12T05:31Z..2026-10-14T14:57Z (431 answers by star-fast); the Luau analyzer reported: "Unknown type 'Players.Player'" in 7 answers on 6 practice tasks (most common unknown type). Night-school lesson L40 with this rule fixed 2 tasks. Roblox class names are usable as types: https://create.roblox.com/docs/luau/type-checking

lessons.text: Luau has no `void` type. A function that returns nothing is annotated `(): ()` and a function type that returns nothing is written `(Player) -> ()`.

lessons.text: Luau comments start with `--`. `//` is the floor-division operator, so a `//` comment line does not compile.

lessons.text: For a typed metatable class keep the class table untyped (`local Stack = {}`, `Stack.__index = Stack`) and type the instances with `export type Stack = typeof(setmetatable({} :: StackData, Stack))`. Annotating the class table itself with the instance type breaks `__index`.

Class pattern: https://create.roblox.com/docs/luau/type-checking

lessons.text: Declare every local (connections, flags, helper functions) before the code that uses it, for example `local connection` above the callback that disconnects it; otherwise Luau reports an unknown global.

lessons.text: In a refund or rollback, check every condition (ownership, price, wallet) before changing any state, then mutate once at the end; a check after the first change can leave coins or items half-applied.

lessons.text: A DataStore session lock must outlive the autosave interval with a margin (for example expiry = now + 2 x autosave + 30 s), and an autosave loop should copy the player list before yielding in UpdateAsync calls.
